title: The morning I nearly missed.

dialogues.speaker: nila
dialogues.text: Last morning in Sri Lanka. Beautiful place. Nobody to share it with. Sound familiar?

dialogues.speaker: nila
dialogues.text: Nila opened Meet Buddy on Tips to Trip and looked for travellers nearby. Someone else was ready to explore too.

dialogues.speaker: nila
dialogues.text: A profile, a shared interest, and a simple hello. She sent a meet request with a quick note.

dialogues.speaker: nila
dialogues.text: The request was sent. Then she waited for a reply. A little later, they made a plan.

dialogues.speaker: nila
dialogues.text: They met for coffee, wandered through the old streets, and watched the ocean. The place was the same. The morning felt completely different.

dialogues.speaker: nila
dialogues.text: Travelling solo? Your next great story could start with hello. Find your people on Tips to Trip.

responseNote: Hi Erin! Fancy a coffee and a walk around Weligama this morning?
